description.name: Entry
description.text: Grants [ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND -50% (25s)], [50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1] and [Quick Cast 3] to all allies, grants [Awoken Princely Courage Mode] and [Song of Courage Mode] to the user

description.name: Awoken Princely Courage Mode
description.text: Bard abilities don't consume uses, cast speed x2.00/2.25/2.50/2.75/3.00 for Bard abilities at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, casts Healing Song after casting Bard abilities

description.name: ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND -50% (25s)
description.text: ATK, DEF, MAG, RES and MND -50%

description.name: 50% Damage Reduction Barrier 1
description.text: Reduces damage taken by 50% for the next attack

description.name: Song of Courage Mode
description.text: Causes [Conditional Imperil 10% (15s)] when another ally uses an ability that deals Fire, Ice, Lightning, Earth, Wind, Water, Holy, Dark or Poison damage, removed after triggering three times

description.name: Conditional Imperil 10% (15s)
description.text: Causes [Imperil Fire 10% (15s)], [Imperil Ice 10% (15s)], [Imperil Lightning 10% (15s)], [Imperil Earth 10% (15s)], [Imperil Wind 10% (15s)], [Imperil Water 10% (15s)], [Imperil Holy 10% (15s)], [Imperil Dark 10% (15s)] or [Imperil Poison 10% (15s)] based on the element of the triggering abilitiy
